description:
## Summary
Port the `/quit` command, which is missing from octo_pi's autocomplete and command dispatcher.

## Observed Upstream Behavior
`/quit` immediately shuts down the application — equivalent to pressing Ctrl+D.

Behavior details:
- Dispatches directly to `this.shutdown()` with no confirmation prompt
- Any in-progress streaming is interrupted before shutdown
- No overlay or status message; the terminal simply returns to the shell
- Equivalent key: Ctrl+D (already handled) — `/quit` is the command form

## Source References
- Dispatch: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts` ~line 2562, search for `"quit"` in the slash-command router
- Shutdown logic: `this.shutdown()` in the same file
- Command registration: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/slash-commands.ts` — entry `"quit"`

## What to Implement in Elixir
1. Add `"quit"` to `builtin_commands/0` in `autocomplete.ex`
2. Add `/quit` dispatch clause that calls the same shutdown path as Ctrl+D
3. No overlay or confirmation; shutdown is immediate
title: Port /quit command
